profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Programming language implementation is my specialty and passion. I’ve been deeply involved with several compilers (e.g., LLVM, GCC, Open64) and some new programming languages (Move, Swift). I’ve also contributed to a variety of developer tools and even helped create new processors (ARM’s AArch64 and Tensilica’s Xtensa).

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Privacy Infra
positions.description: Building tools to validate Meta's systems to protect users' privacy

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Move Platform Team
positions.description: Supporting the team developing the Move programming language and related technologies

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Mentored and supported first-level managers for several teams working on Swift, LLDB and LLVM
- Directly managed engineers working on compiler runtime libraries and Swift performance optimizations
- Led a multi-year cross-functional project to lock down a stable ABI for Swift and to ship the Swift standard library as part of Apple’s OS platforms
- Focused on strengthening internal processes for the Swift team, e.g., bug report screening, branch management and release qualification

positions.title: Engineering Manager, LLVM Core Team
positions.description:
- Led a team of 10 engineers that was responsible for various components of the Apple LLVM compiler as well as testing and coordinating compiler releases for all of Apple’s platforms
- Some of the larger projects that I led were: link-time optimization, profile-guided optimization, transitions away from GCC and llvm-gcc, type-based alias analysis, and code coverage tools
- Played a leading role in several cross-functional projects: overhauling Apple’s command line tools, bitcode submissions to the App Store, and developer tool support for watchOS apps
- Many of these projects were large efforts that required coordination with teams across the company
- Gained a lot of experience in productizing and releasing complex software with many dependencies

positions.title: Compiler Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented LLVM’s initial support for the ARM Neon vector instruction set
- Improved LLVM compiler optimizations to be competitive with GCC for some internal projects
- Led the transition to building iOS with llvm-gcc instead of GCC
- Made major contributions to the LLVM backend for 64-bit ARM targets

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- As an early employee, I provided technical leadership in the design of Tensilica's configurable and extensible Xtensa microprocessor solutions, particularly in the areas of software development tools and system software for Xtensa
- Created and maintained much of Tensilica's internal software architecture and build processes
- Specified the Xtensa software ABI and contributed to the design of the Xtensa instruction set
- Ported the GCC compiler to Xtensa and served as the maintainer for the Xtensa ports of GCC and the GNU binary utilities, with significant work on other open-source projects

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Led the development of SunSoft's just-in-time (JIT) compiler for Java on SPARC systems
- Participated in review of the Java Language Specification
- Contributed to development of a high-performance Java virtual machine with precise garbage collection

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Redesigned and implemented the core of the SUIF system, a flexible infrastructure for research on parallelizing and optimizing compilers, and used that infrastructure to develop an interprocedural pointer alias analysis algorithm

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Helped develop the core infrastructure of the MIPSpro compiler (which later became the Open64 compiler), with a focus on the framework for link-time interprocedural optimizations
